column1: # apply is stack-only in BOTH overloads (NUR098's fix, 2026-08-24): the
# reach-lens overload moved from BarrierPos -1 to 0, so the forward-lens
# spellings refuse exactly as the Function overload's always have. The
# POSITIVE stack rows live in the main corpus (lang/spec/apply.tsv §5,
# lang/spec/reach.tsv §2); these two NEGATIVES live here because their
# check-time no-match takes the checker's best-fit RECOVERY path
# ("assuming best-fit candidate for analysis"), and a recovered dispatch
# refuses compilation rather than compiling the error-trap program the
# main corpus's refusal ceiling (0) requires. The interpreter — the
# oracle — raises the designed signature_error. Graduation = the
# unmatched-dispatch trap accepting a RECOVERED window (compiling these
# to the same trap `5 apply` already gets), at which point both rows
